draft.title: Perimeter and area
card: Perimeter
the distance around the outside of a shape, in units such as cm or m. Add the lengths of all the sides.
Area
the space inside a shape, in square units such as cm² or m². Rectangle: A = l × w. Triangle: A = ½ × b × h, where h is the height at right angles to the base.
Trapezium
A = ½ × (a + b) × h, where a and b are the parallel sides. Circle: A = πr², and the perimeter (circumference) is C = 2πr.
Composite shapes
Split the shape into rectangles, triangles and so on, then add the areas. Example: a 6 m by 4 m rectangle with a triangle of base 6 m and height 3 m on top has area 24 + ½ × 6 × 3 = 24 + 9 = 33 m².
draft.remember: Perimeter adds the sides. Area fills the inside, so split a complex shape into simple parts.

a.q: A trapezium has parallel sides of 5 cm and 9 cm, and a height of 4 cm. What is its area?
a.why: A = ½ × (5 + 9) × 4 = ½ × 14 × 4 = 28 cm². Leaving out the ½ gives 56 cm², which is the tempting mistake.
a.clue: Add the parallel sides, then multiply by the height and halve.

b.q: Mia's garden bed is a rectangle 8 m by 5 m with a semicircle-free cut: a right triangle with base 4 m and height 3 m is removed from one corner. What is the area of the bed?
b.why: The rectangle is 8 × 5 = 40 m². The removed triangle is ½ × 4 × 3 = 6 m². So the bed is 40 − 6 = 34 m². Forgetting the ½ would remove 12 m² and give 28 m², and not removing anything gives 40 m².
b.clue: Find the area of the whole rectangle, then take away the triangle's area.

problems.detail: The phrase "with a semicircle-free cut" is confusing and meaningless. It may make students look for a semicircle. It should just say a right triangle is removed from one corner.
The why says forgetting the ½ gives 28 m², but 28 m² is not an option. The actual distractors are 37 m² and 46 m², and the why does not explain them.

The card only teaches splitting a composite shape and adding the areas. This question needs subtracting a removed part, which the card never shows. Add a line such as "or subtract any part that is cut out".

b.q: Mia's garden bed is an 8 m by 5 m rectangle with a right triangle cut out of one corner. The triangle has base 4 m and height 3 m. What is the area of the bed?

b.clue: The triangle is cut out, so take its area away.
